source_truth.primary_source: U.S. EPA Office of Water — WATERS Services REST API
source_truth.geofabric: NHDPlus V2.1 (Puerto Rico = VPU 21; Vogel/VPUAttribute extensions unavailable -> attribute_coverage stamped partial)

real_data_sources.aee_incidents: data/aee_incidents.jsonl is the committed reproducible 2025-03-03 SuperSonicHub1 CC0 snapshot at T2/needs_review. Direct MiLUMA town observations are written only to gitignored data/luma_live_incidents.jsonl, receipt-bound to exact source bytes/retrieval UTC, and never overwrite the historical manifestation.
real_data_sources.luma_regional_status: data/luma_status_snapshots.jsonl is runtime-only append history from MiLUMA /outage/regionsWithoutService. Each row preserves RAW_UNFROZEN payload plus logical SHA-256 and exact source-byte SHA-256/byte count from /tmp/luma_snapshot_manifest.json; source-unavailable does not synthesize zero.
real_data_sources.luma_regional_status_changes: data/luma_status_changes.jsonl is a deterministic adjacent-snapshot derivative built only from receipt-verified regional snapshots. It certifies SOURCE_STATE_CHANGE|SOURCE_STATE_UNCHANGED from payload hashes while restoration_state and outage_lifecycle_state remain UNRESOLVED; snapshot change/disappearance alone never certifies restoration.
real_data_sources.preb_reliability_docket: runtime-only data/preb_reliability_docket.jsonl + data/preb_reliability_docket_summary.json from PREB docket NEPR-MI-2019-0007. Producer requires arithmetic closure between PREB's advertised published-document denominator and parsed document rows; RAW title/subject/date strings are preserved separately from normalized discovery fields. PREB monthly/quarterly reliability filings are NONCOMPARABLE_BY_DEFAULT to MiLUMA live outage snapshots.
real_data_sources.pr_municipios_geo: data/geo/pr_municipios.json (Census Gazetteer centroids: normalization + spatial joins) + data/geo/pr_municipios.geojson (78 municipio polygons) + data/geo/pr_barrios.geojson (901 barrios, each linked to its municipio) for the map layer; U.S. Census cartographic boundaries (public domain), WGS84
real_data_sources.neon_availability: data/neon_availability.jsonl + data/neon_publication_events.jsonl (NSF NEON API v0, data.neonscience.org/api/v0/sites; Domain D04 'Atlantic Neotropical' = the 4 Puerto Rico sites CUPE/GUAN/GUIL/LAJA). Keyless T1 federal feed: per-site/product availableMonths state and the publication-change delta derived from it (scripts/ingest_neon.py). Licence CC BY 4.0 per NEON's data policy (neonscience.org/data-samples/data-policies-citation-guidelines).
real_data_sources.neon_readings: data/neon_readings.jsonl (NSF NEON API v0 /data/{product}/{site}/{month}; scripts/ingest_neon_products.py). Stream discharge, surface-water elevation and surface-water chemistry at CUPE/GUIL as monitoring_reading rows, daily-aggregated with NEON QA-flagged records dropped. NOTE: this endpoint is token-gated (see waf_blocked_sources) and the live download path is UNVERIFIED — built and tested against synthetic fixtures only, pending a NEON_API_TOKEN. Runtime-only file, not committed, like every other time-series reading source.
real_data_sources.luma_live_incidents: gitignored data/luma_live_incidents.jsonl — runtime-only direct MiLUMA municipality/town observations. Ingest requires a PASS towns receipt, verifies response SHA-256 + byte count, uses receipt retrieval UTC as observation time, deletes the prior live file before a new receipt-bound attempt, and is age-gated to one hour in backend/export consumption.

source_truth.direct_miluma_handling: INTERNAL_RUNTIME_ONLY: exact direct-MiLUMA response bytes and endpoint receipts live under /tmp; normalized live town rows remain gitignored and age-gated; committed historical aee_incidents stays a separate manifestation. Region payload semantics remain RAW_UNFROZEN until successful source bytes establish a stable field schema.

hub_callable_commands.setup: python -m pip install uv && uv pip install --system -e .[dev]

advisory: PREPS service_events remain island-wide aggregates; per-municipality outage attribution is now provided by aee_incidents (LUMA outages_by_town) at tier T2/needs_review (third-party snapshot) — promote to T1 if/when a direct utility feed is wired
advisory: source datasets (Energy_Sector, preps_*, outages_by_town.json, Census gazetteer) live outside the repo; ingest scripts default to local paths (override with --src)

water-monitoring analytic layer built: scripts/build_water_alerts.py promotes real EPA SDWIS boil-water + health-based quality violations to CONTAMINATION AlertEvents (T1), plus a T2/needs_review reservoir-low HYDRO_OPS proxy; scripts/build_water_power_crosswalk.py adds water->power `energizes` edges (closes GAP-003); the WATERS NHDPlus enricher is wired (scripts/enrich_waters_nhd.py). Rich asset attributes + energized_by relationships now flow to thehub-pr. Proxies are transparently tier-tagged; T1 unblocks (AAA operating levels, utility feeder map, WATERS key) recorded in docs/ROAD_TO_100.md.

MiLUMA provenance hardening: the two independently corroborated outage surfaces are acquired separately; exact response bytes + endpoint receipts bind retrieval UTC/SHA-256/byte counts; live town observations cannot overwrite the committed 2025 mirror and are age-gated to one hour; regional payload remains RAW_UNFROZEN pending successful source-schema evidence.

centinelas_pr_only_gaps: PREB (Puerto Rico Energy Bureau) regulatory filings: document-based portal, no structured API. aguayluz-pr directly indexes the complete NEPR-MI-2019-0007 public docket metadata with advertised-count closure for the reliability source family; centinelas-pr remains the filing/news signal layer. PREB retrospective reliability metrics are not promoted to MiLUMA live outage state.

AAA/PRASA boil-water notices: the AAA portal is a Webflow marketing site with no public API — SDWIS T1 microbial violations (ingest_sdwis_violations.py) are the authoritative regulatory boil-water signal; individual AAA press-release notices route through centinelas-pr -> ingest_news_event.py at T3
waf_blocked_sources: MiLUMA / api.miluma.lumapr.com: Incapsula WAF blocks plain automated access; GET /miluma-outage-api/outage/regionsWithoutService returned HTTP 403 on 2026-09-19. The two independently corroborated outage surfaces are municipality/towns and regionsWithoutService. fetch_luma_live.py treats them independently, removes stale temp outputs, freezes exact successful response bytes + SHA-256 receipts, and never maps source failure to zero. A formal PREB/LUMA data-sharing arrangement remains the durable path to T1 attribution.

NEON /api/v0/data/{product}/{site}/{month} (data.neonscience.org): returns HTTP 403 {'error':{'status':403,'detail':'Access Denied'}} to anonymous callers — NEON's own gateway, verified against sibling paths on the same host that answer 200. Requires a free NEON API token (data.neonscience.org/myaccount) sent as the X-API-Token header; note that an INVALID token also yields 403, even on endpoints that are open anonymously. Activate via refresh.py --weekly/--all (optional step: scripts/ingest_neon_products.py prints a skip notice and exits 0 when the token is absent). NEON *metadata* — sites, products, releases, and the availableMonths publication signal this producer's alerts are built on — needs no credential and is unaffected.
